# Synthetic MinerU OCR fixture

`synthetic_scan.png` is a deterministic, two-line 8-bit grayscale raster generated by
`drilling_intelligence.integrations.mineru.qualification.synthetic_fixture_png()` using a
small embedded 5×7 bitmap alphabet. It contains no field data, user document, model, or weight.
`ground_truth.txt` is the exact source text used for the fixture's character-error-rate (CER) and
word-error-rate (WER) calculations.

The generator is standard-library-only and produces the same PNG bytes on each supported Python
runtime. The public operator command uses the same generator in a temporary directory; it does not
upload documents or download models. `drillintel mineru validate` checks local CLI readiness only.
`drillintel mineru validate --run-synthetic-ocr` explicitly runs the generated image through the
local MinerU 4 CLI with `MINERU_MODEL_SOURCE=local`, the ONNX small-model backend, and Basic tier.
Missing local models fail closed; model download is a separate, user-controlled MinerU operation.

A passing metric is only a result for this one synthetic fixture. It does not qualify OCR accuracy
on real scans, handwriting, tables, other languages, or field documents.
